name: fp-yoohoo
description: Terminal-recall mode. When Claude Code stops to ask you something (a permission prompt, a question dialog, an agent blocked on input) it brings the terminal window to the front, unless it already has focus. Works on KDE, Hyprland, sway, X11, macOS and Windows, with a bell and desktop notification where no window can be raised. Pure mechanism. Modes: off, hint, on (default).
